hypothesis: A trend-aligned rejection during a V18-flat interval becomes an executable auction result only when the first complete minute after its trigger produces movement in the proposed direction in both dominant CL price discovery and matched-month MCL transport. This direct result should reject immediate errors without relying on a volatility derivative or reducing the relay below useful cadence.

profile.source: exact V43 trend-aligned rejection events while immutable V18 is flat
profile.confirmation_clock: the one-minute MCL entry bar originally projected by V43, observed only after that bar completes
profile.confirmation: proposed_direction * (close - open) > 0 independently for matched CL and MCL
profile.entry: next one-minute MCL open after confirmation; require same contract, session, contiguous clock, and V18 still flat
profile.neighbor_policy: none; exactly one minute, strict sign, and no magnitude threshold

frozen_order: load the unchanged V43 aligned and V18-flat event set and immutable V18 intervals
inspect only the first complete one-minute CL and MCL bar at each event's originally projected entry
retain the event only when both open-to-close moves have the proposed sign
shift entry exactly one minute and reject any contract/session/clock discontinuity or V18 incumbent
count discovery and validation periods without reading return, MFE, MAE, exit, PnL, or validation outcome
advance only if both periods independently pass every breadth, density, and combined-cadence floor
if_eligible: Preregister one reuse of the exact V44 non-overlapping lifecycle with the delayed frozen events. Discovery must independently pass add-on net, PF, PnL/DD, month, concentration, all-cohort, and combined-no-weaker-than-V18 gates under both costs before validation opens.
prohibitions: no confirmation magnitude, bar-count, CL-only, MCL-only, or bar-shape sweep
no ATR acceleration, ATR level, ATR velocity, coherence, state-age, slope, month, anchor, side, branch, or direction companion gate
no V18 mutation or concurrent MCL position
no trade outcome before count eligibility and a separate lifecycle preregistration
no order, capital, XSP, or Gold authority
downstream_hold_even_on_pass: missing July 2023 through August 2024 dated-contract history
unseen runtime parity and prospective signal tape
native MCL spread, liquidity, margin, commission, roll, preview, restart, reconciliation, shared-capital, and graduation proof
